### Week commencing December 9th

#### Highlight offers

![64 2 Large](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/5w9YfoVRaFGlkGDUv6gnqC/23e2a0cc650eb27bc2419865262e3b36/64_2_Large.png)

Starting December 9th, the Holiday Decorations Pack will be available in the shop for a limited time!

*Note: The Burning Night Weather Control Station aurora is only visible at night.*

Item Atoms Holiday Decoration Pack 1,800 Northern Lights Pack 2,400 We're Looking Forward to Snow Pack 1,800 Weather Control Station (Burning Night) 1,500 Christmas Elf Repair Bot 700 Plastic Holiday Tree 500 Large Iron Hearth 500 State Room Fireplace 350 Decorative Bird Cage 250 #### Weekly offers

This week the Atomic Shop is back with daily offers! Each item is always available until 6:00 p.m. CET the following day.

*Note: Weekly offers are subject to change.*

Item Atoms Available on Double-Barreled Shotgun Wrap (Double-Dunk) 250 (-50%) December 9th Gauss Shotgun Wrap (Intelligence) 250 (-50%) December 10th Pumpgun Wrap (Ziegelhaus' Armor Ace) 250 (-50%) December 11th Pumpgun Wrap (First Responders) 250 (-50%) December 12th Double Barrel Shotgun Paint (Union) 250 (-50%) December 13th Combat Shotgun Paint (Free States) 250 (-50%) December 14th Pump Gun Paint (Roar at 'Em) 375 (-50%) December 15th
